body:
I have been on Klonopin for a while to counteract the horrible stimulant comedown effects of Adderall. It worked like a charm for a good long while but then its like I build up such a tolerance it takes a ridiculous amount to achieve the same effects. Sometimes if I change the benzo I use I will get better relief. Like if I take xanax for a little while or maybe valium. Sometimes its like I have to take a lortab too and have maybe a beer to act as a catalyst. That's a long road to nowhere though.
Anyway I guess they'll never figure out how to best counteract Adderall successfully for a long period of time.
When I take like a month off of everything though Klonopin is fun to take on its own again but that's about the only time.
